model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the relative distribution of percentages related to various sectors in the years 2014 (inner circle) and 2021 (outer circle). The chart contains 14 slices representing different categories. Starting from the largest and moving clockwise, the slices are labeled “Übrige” (grey) at 38.1% in 2014 and a smaller proportion in 2021, “Wohnungswesen” (light green) at 7.2% in 2014 and a larger proportion in 2021, “Abwasserversorgung” (light blue) at 7.8%, “Stromversorgung” (green) at 4.0%, “Gasversorgung” (dark blue) at 1.5%, “Wasserversorgung” (blue) at 8.8%, “Kombinierte Versorgung” (purple) at 5.5%, “Übrige Versorgung” (dark grey) at 1.3%, “Verkehr” (orange) at 3.7%, “Wirtschaftsförderung” (pink) at 4.7%, “Kliniken” (light pink) at 3.2%, “Sport/Erholung” (dark green) at 3.6%, and “Kultur” (grey) at 2.2%. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The slices appear to be arranged in descending order based on their size in the 2014 circle, and the 2021 proportions are overlaid on top of the 2014 proportions. A legend is not present, but the labels are directly on the chart.
